title: An import shows nothing until it finishes, so a large one is indistinguishable from a hang — mount a spinner card the moment a file is dropped

summary: User-requested after MPI-670's live check: the import works but is silent, and they killed a 474 MiB one thinking it had hung. Reusing the generation placeholder shape the grid already renders, and emitting from uploadMediaFile so all four ingest surfaces get it.

Placeholder is up within 200ms of a real drop event and replaced by the finished card at 1.6s, with no gap. Needed one thing the plan did not: setGenerating deliberately HIDES the spinner in favour of the mascot, so an import rendered a mascot promising a model was cooking - added setImporting as its twin, spinner shown, mascot suppressed. All 10 setGroups sites now route through _leadingGroups(); two of them were dropping the generation placeholders entirely. eslint clean, npm test 831 pass.
